reserves.name: Aggregate Solstice attested reserves
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Solstice Finance and undisclosed cash, Treasury, custody, and hedge counterparties

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open on 2026-07-28 reconfirmed dual independent sources: (1) solstice.finance/usx and docs.solstice.finance USX page both name the same three reserve categories—audited cash, tokenized Treasuries, and delta-neutral hedged positions in major digital assets—without category weights; (2) attestation-api.solstice.finance/dashboard returned collateralization 1.003922, total_reserves 525039528.63 USD, total_supply 522988257.04 USD, latest reserves.timeline point date 2026-07-22, delta_neutral true and overcollateralized true, with cryptographic SEV/merkle/zkp material, but no asset-level balances, category keys, or composition fields under reserves (keys limited to total_reserves, total_supply, timeline, verifiability, interval, delta_neutral, overcollateralized). The complete reserve is therefore retained as one conservatively high-risk aggregate rather than assigning unsupported constituents or weights. The slice name remains aligned to the solstice-attestation adapter row identity.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Solstice collateral disclosure and aggregate reserve-versus-supply attestation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The current split among audited cash, tokenized Treasuries, and delta-neutral hedged positions is not published; underlying instruments, custodian shares, execution venues, and hedge counterparties are also undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Solstice names three broad reserve categories, but the aggregate attestation does not establish current category or instrument weights.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Solstice names Copper and Ceffu as third-party custodians (USX docs collateral-flow step; risk disclosures custody counterparty section; product page institutional custody and partner logos) but does not publish their current shares, identify hedge venues, or establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms for the complete reserve.
